instructions_to_main_agent: Update `tailwind.config.js` with the custom colors (burgundy, beige, gold, text) provided in the palette.
Do NOT use pure white or generic grays. Stick strictly to the Beige (#E6C7A8) and Burgundy (#6E2C2C) theme for a premium feel.
For the Landing page hero section, create an elegant composition using the provided logo URL and the hero image.
For the Category section, use arch-shaped cards (`rounded-t-full`) to give a traditional Indian boutique aesthetic.
In the Gallery page, implement a masonry grid layout for images and Instagram reels/videos.
In the Admin panel, use standard Shadcn components but style them using the brand palette (Burgundy sidebar, Beige highlights).
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="book-appointment-btn"`).
Add a sticky floating WhatsApp button at the bottom right with a pulsing or bouncing animation.
Use Shadcn calendar and form components for the Appointment Booking section.
For all images, use ONLY the URLs provided in the `media` section. Do NOT use placeholders.
